We need to output JSON with task: the task I (agent A) took in the completed round. According to the completed allocation, A took T4. So "task":"T4". Note: handoff message describing completed allocation and convention. Must be <=2000 chars. Provide JSON with two fields.

Thus produce something like:

{
 "task":"T4",
 "note":"In the previous round, the joint allocation was A->T4, B->T3. C and D chose T1 and T2 respectively, resulting in 4 distinct tasks, no violations, total cost 41, total reward 359. For the next round, keep the convention that A takes T4 and B takes T3, while C and D will select the cheapest remaining tasks. ..."
}

Make sure not to include extra labels. Return only JSON.
